sources.authorship: Varian Cary WinUV Help, manufacturer-authored manual mirrored by Caltech
sources.review: PDF pp. 9-19, 33-42: sphere/port dimensions, envelope and mass, removable S/D cap, sample clamps, reference disks, installation and reflection handling; figures 10 and 11 visually inspected.
Legacy required 0010079800 extension: 154 x 212 x 170 mm interior, approximately 180 mm added depth, keyhole mount and removable/hinged cover. Keep separate from 2021 flyer dimensional statement.

vendor_resource_search.result: Manufacturer-authored dimensional manual and photographs found; no downloadable model CAD located in these searches.

variant_resolution: The paper does not identify accessory generation. Legacy 0010081100 is an explicit reconstruction choice.
Use the manual 16 mm reflectance port and 140 x 340 x 200 mm, 5 kg module. Later sample-size tables do not replace these interface dimensions.
This is the internal 110 mm sphere, not the external 150 mm sphere or a generic cylinder.
15-pin D-range connector with two high-voltage pins is stated by the manual, but exact contact layout and mating dimensions are unresolved. No invented pin array or electrical/mating credit.
inferences: Local housing proportions, sphere location, cap-carrier geometry, clamp shape, spring geometry and lock-down foot/pin sizes are inferred.
Reference holder dimensions are inferred around the source 44.45 mm diameter and 6 mm PTFE layer.
Optical paths, detector function, contact compliance and force requirements are not qualified by the static asset.

The 5 kg source module exceeds the current 3 kg Panda payload. Installation requires an adequately rated handler or a physically modeled support assist; it cannot receive credit from the current Panda lift.
